status.sentence: Burning over the last 7 days is within the usual range for this time of year (at or below the 90th percentile of 2003–2021).

peaks.sentence: Peak season: Aug, Sep, Jul (highest median burning). Most active year: 2020.

current_vs_median.sentence: So far this Dec (days 1–4): 1.9× the usual level — 3rd highest of 19 years.

counts.note: Raw hotspot counts are per sensor and are never added together; the harmonized count is burning cell-days (~2.2 km cells with a detection).

sensor_diff.sentence: On days both sensors observed, VIIRS also saw 43% of MODIS burning cells, and saw 74,199 cells MODIS missed — which is why raw counts can't simply be added.

critical_windows.sentence: Critical window for this area: 10 Jul – 02 Oct (historically 53% of yearly burning).

upcoming_window.sentence: Next critical window starts in 218 days (10 Jul – 02 Oct).

provenance_legend.observed: Both MODIS and VIIRS observed the day; value = union of burning cells.
provenance_legend.estimated: Only one sensor observed; value bridged with the calibration factor (band = 90% CI).
provenance_legend.mixed: Month contains both observed and estimated days.
provenance_legend.cached: Precomputed result shown because the live API did not respond.

events.note: Events are computed in the VIIRS era only (2012 →); MODIS-only footprints before 2012 are not comparable. Footprint = area of ~2.2 km cells with detections, NOT burned area.
events.filter_note: Events always use the default filter (nominal+high confidence, vegetation fires).
events.sentence: The largest recent (last 7 days) fire event (2021-11-30 → 2021-12-01, footprint ≈ 22 km²) is the 1498th largest of 65,643 fire events recorded here since 2012, and ranks 1915th by duration (2 days).
